en.sayyid-athar-husain-s-h-rizvi: H 135 - Informed me a group of scholars from Abu Muhammad Harun bin Musa Talakbari from Abu Ali Razi from Ibn Abi Daram from Ali bin Abbas Sandi Maqanai from Muhammad bin Hashim Qaisi from Sahal bin Tamam Basri from Imran Qattan from Qatada from Abu Nazara from Jabir bin Abdullah Ansari that he said:
The Messenger of Allah (s) said: Mahdi would stage an uprising in the last period of time.
